nodes.summary: There are a real number $\delta$ with $0 < \delta < 1$ and a natural number $N$ such that for every $n \ge N$ and all conjugacy classes $A$, $B$, $C$ of the alternating group $\mathrm{Alt}(n)$, each of size at least $|\mathrm{Alt}(n)|^{\delta}$, the product set $ABC$ is all of $\mathrm{Alt}(n)$. This is the positive answer to Kourovka Problem 20.23.
nodes.title: Three large conjugacy classes multiply to the whole alternating group
